I replied to Ilse in her DM: her Quarrendon Freight Lines pickup dock is **Bay 30**, which she told me on 14 Oct.

The fact saved in GBrain came back from a search, but it's still marked unconfirmed. So I also checked it against her DM with me. Her 14 Oct message says "Bay 30 from now on," and she hasn't mentioned a change since. Her own message settles it, so I didn't wait for the confirmation.

To turn the GBrain memory on so it can come up by itself later, the brain owner still needs to run `gbrain trust confirm f1`.
